project: PAPER-D1 general-purpose multi-shot paper film director

sources.title: Kraken LED Light Box
sources.creator: Computer Aided Crafting
sources.rights: All artwork rights reserved or unverified; visual study only, no copying

analysis.construction: Eight distinct darker front-to-back cardstock silhouette planes; central vehicle and tentacle subject surrounded by framed foreground palms
analysis.material: Hard opaque dark shape edges with optical color separation from lamps behind physically stacked paper
analysis.microdetail: Fine tree fronds and tentacle negative-space openings; only small thumbnail was inspected, so precise edge dimensions are unverified
analysis.light: Bright central moon and warm-cool depth separation; not replicated as a gradient paper filter

crops.observation: foreground palm framing remains distinct from distant ship and moon
crops.implementation_rule: retain independent full-color opaque cutouts, depth and camera motion; do not flatten frame to a single atlas

sources.title: Enchanted Paper Light Box
sources.creator: Aline Maire
sources.rights: Copyrighted artwork; image linked for private study only
sources.medium: hand-cut layered paper and transmitted light

analysis.construction: Top and side framing branches form attached large and fine networks over a glowing negative-space portal
analysis.material: Multiple opaque paper silhouettes; large openings pass light through actual physical negative space
analysis.microdetail: Branch-lace interstices and hanging foliage; source thumbnail does not support measuring micro-thickness
analysis.light: Backlight separates silhouetted architecture of branches and a focal central moon

crops.observation: dark twisted branches connected from the edge frame, not random stickers
crops.implementation_rule: preserve existing authored branch sheet and never animate its leaves independently from their hinge

sources.title: Film and Animation at Key Stage 2
sources.creator: CCEA (Council for the Curriculum, Examinations & Assessment)
sources.rights: Educational reference only; no pages redistributed
sources.medium: paper cutout stop motion and silhouette animation teaching guide

analysis.construction: Top-down cut-paper work depends on layered parts and visible joints rather than a plastic deformation filter
analysis.microdetail: Specific temporal motion frames not inspected

feature_targets.source_observation: multiple independent solid cut-paper stocks with visible depth and designed openings
feature_targets.geometry_rule: reuse PAPER1 closed contour and holes; keep opacity 1 for completed subjects
feature_targets.test_view: Storybook landscape and portrait full-frame + close crop

feature_targets.source_observation: parts should remain connected through shared base/joint, not random floating transforms
feature_targets.geometry_rule: group moth sheets under identical pose keyframes; preserve existing wing rigs
feature_targets.test_view: motion frames before and after butterfly sweep

feature_targets.source_observation: physical framing and depth must survive virtual camera moves; paper does not dissolve into ghost alpha
feature_targets.geometry_rule: bounded camera keyframes and hard cuts at chapter boundaries; cap movement to keep backing safe

notes.source_gate: Thumbnail-level viewing only. High-resolution licensed source crops not retained: geometry exact-match gate not claimed.
notes.scope: Style-guided generic film framework; original authored paper assets retained from existing PAPER1 packs; no third-party pixels included.
notes.motion_gate: No external source motion clip inspected frame-by-frame; timed model based on authored edit rhythm and actual output review. Independent artistic sign-off remains separate.
